svg.text: Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350 — 6-Segment Hardware PWM LED Bar Graph
400-Tie-Point Solderless Breadboard Layout | ADC0: D0/A0 (GPIO26) | PWM LEDs: D1–D6 (GPIO27, 28, 5, 6, 7, 0)

g.text: XIAO Pin GPIO Device Role / Segment
3V3 Pin 12 LDO Out +3.3 V Supply Rail
GND Pin 13 Ground 0.0 V Common Return
Row 1: Pot Lug 1 (1E) → Jumper 1A to Left +3V3
Row 3: Pot Lug 3 (3E) → Jumper 3A to Left GND
Row 5: XIAO D0 (5E) | 100nF Cap (5B to Left GND)
Row 6: XIAO D1 (6E) | XIAO GND (6F) → Right GND
